research.swa_research.echo_observation.s: At the Hoth archive, take the archivist's lesson and touch the radio operator's recovered glove. Read the impression it holds. The holocron keeps the observation for you to revisit at the archive.
research.swa_research.psychometry.title: Testing the Evidence
research.swa_research.psychometry.stage_: Compare the recovered glove with an identical spare from storage. Record what you observed in each object. What differs if the gloves are made from the same material?

Make a prediction before you examine the signal officer's metal tag. Will a different material fail to produce an echo, or can an object still retain a trace of a lived event? Record your prediction at the archive table.

Read the tag. If a different material also gives an echo, the evidence contradicts the theory about the glove's material. Revise a failed prediction and test again. Once verified, complete the entry and try the buckle by the loading ramp.
message.swa_research.dispatch_locked: Dispatch: Complete Change the Callsign before picking up the Hoth recording.
message.swa_research.site_unavailable: Dispatch: The Hoth station has not responded. Request its coordinates again.
message.swa_research.briefing: Dispatch: Someone used our old callsign to request a landing corridor on Hoth. Fly to Hoth at X %s, Y %s, Z %s. Find the evacuation diagram and emergency recorder at the station, locate the shelter, then report back here.
message.swa_research.coordinates: Hoth signal station coordinates. X %s, Y %s, Z %s.
message.swa_research.briefing_required: Pick up the landing request recording from dispatch on Tatooine first.
message.swa_research.recorder_off: The recorder has no power. Connect the backup circuit at the next console.
message.swa_research.recorder_powered: The backup circuit is connected. Play the emergency recording at the recorder.
message.swa_research.recorder_signal: Emergency recording: Two knocks on the bulkhead. ‘Hold on. I'll get you to shelter.’
message.swa_research.wiring_east: Line A goes to the east shelter, line B to the west. The double signal was wired to A on this shift.
message.swa_research.wiring_west: Line A goes to the east shelter, line B to the west. The double signal was wired to B on this shift.
message.swa_research.shelter_clues: You can inspect the shelter. For the report, check the evacuation diagram and find out which signal was used at the airlock.
message.swa_research.shelter_empty: Nobody is here. The entry panel recorded only a single test pulse. Compare the emergency recording with the diagram.
message.swa_research.shelter_found: A double signal comes from behind the airlock. The signal officer answers and shows you the log. The borrowed callsign let them secure a corridor and reach shelter. Report back to Tatooine.
message.swa_research.report_east: Dispatch: The signal officer is in the east shelter. A rescue ship is on its way. I've logged the callsign incident.
message.swa_research.report_west: Dispatch: The signal officer is in the west shelter. A rescue ship is on its way. I've logged the callsign incident.
message.swa_research.kit_clue: A service seam runs beneath the white marks on the ramp. The field kit is by the third mark.
message.swa_research.kit_locked: The field-kit grille is locked. Find the signal officer and examine the white marks on the ramp.
message.swa_research.kit_reward: Field kit found. The crew can claim it from the case entry in the quest log.
